what_happened: Style/layout 10 (microwave on a tall cabinet, same as s7 and s15; door with a vertical handle bar at its free edge, round Start/Stop keys at the end of the keypad). Stage 0: garlic grasped at 137, released into the black bowl at 279, stage 0 at 281; the garlic rolls in the bowl during the carry (many one-step undo blips) but ends in it. Stage 1: bowl grasped at 386, released inside at 728, stage 1 at 745 (464 steps). Stage 2: the gripper came from the left below the door and pushed the bottom of the door glass 849-950: closedness 0.09 (848) -> 0.67 (880) -> 0.88 (912), bounced back to 0.77 (928) when the push slipped, then 0.93-0.94 by 960-976 with the gripper ending at the handle bar. With the door ~6% open it left for the keypad (1000-1040) and never touched the door again; closedness stayed 0.94 to the end. Stage 3 behaviour: presses at 1064-1076 (between Timed Defrost and Stop), 1107-1114 (blank bezel just below Start) and 1161-1177 (blank area beside Start); all missed the Start key by about one key width, so turned_on stayed 0 even though the door was ajar enough to allow it. It then hovered above the keypad (1200-1400), as in s7 and s15.
causal_chain: door pushed to 0.94 closedness by 976 (needs >= 0.995) -> policy moves on to the keypad as if the door were shut -> three near-miss presses around Start 1064-1177 -> hovers -> door still ajar and microwave off at timeout
self_recovery: repeated the press three times with small shifts; never went back to finish the door.
official_criterion_notes: The door at 0.94 closedness looks almost shut in the agent view (small gap at the handle side). The criterion (opening <= 0.5%) is strict but it is a real gap; not a false negative.
uncertain_about: Why the push stopped at 0.94 (no obstruction seen; the gripper simply moved on). The press offsets are read from the wrist view.
